step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a security operations center (SOC) log processing and incident response pipeline. On the left, log sources originate from On-Premise (OnPremDC) and AWS Cloud Services (decomposed into CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SQS, SNS per transcript and Rule 4). These sources feed into Apache Metron (ThirdParty) for real-time parsing, enrichment, and profiling. Processed data flows to Amazon EMR within the Security Data Lake, which writes persistent parquet/transformed data to Amazon S3. Amazon Athena queries the S3 data lake for analytics and forensics, providing a contextual feedback loop back into Apache Metron. On the response side, Metron sends alert events to a SOAR platform (ThirdParty), which alerts the SOC Analyst (UserCompanyAnalyst), who then triggers automated mitigation via AWS WAF.
